title.zh: 费率与复利 · 1% 的费率怎么吃掉回报
title.en: Fees & Compounding · How Does a 1% Fee Eat Returns

desc.zh: 费率从收益率里扣，1% 乘上 30 年复利，能吃掉约四分之一终值。
desc.en: A fee comes out of the return every year; 1% compounded over 30 years eats roughly a quarter of the final value.
